label: Operator instructs
definition: The mechanism's operator (for example NESO or the DNO) decides when the provider delivers and sends it instructions. The operator is the org_id with role operator in MECHANISM_ORG_ROLE.

label: Self-dispatched
definition: Nobody instructs the provider. It either responds automatically to a measured signal such as system frequency, or sets its own output to meet the position it has traded, as in GB's self-dispatch wholesale market.

label: Not applicable
definition: Nothing is physically dispatched, for example a cash-settled financial contract.
